 intro 
 Are you an experienced EPT Driver who likes to keep things moving? Do you enjoy working in a busy warehouse where teamwork, efficiency and safety come first? Then we've got the perfect job for you! You'll make sure fresh herbs and other products reach the right place at the right time. You'll join a growing international company with a friendly team and plenty of opportunities to develop your skills. Ready to get started? 
 who are you 
 - You have experience operating an electric pallet truck (EPT) - You have previous experience in logistics or warehouse operations - Experience operating a forklift or reach truck is a plus, but not required - You can communicate in English - You work accurately, independently and always put safety first - You're a team player with a flexible and proactive attitude - You're available to work in 3 shifts: 06:00-14:00, 14:00-22:00 and 22:00-06:00 - You live in or around Venlo or Grubbenvorst 
 what are you going to do 
 As an EPT Driver , you'll play an important role in keeping the logistics process running smoothly. You'll work at a growing international company specialising in fresh herbs, such as mint, parsley, thyme and rosemary. These products are processed, packed and shipped to customers across Europe, and you'll make sure everything moves efficiently through the warehouse. 
Your main responsibility is transporting goods safely and efficiently using an electric pallet truck (EPT). You'll unload incoming deliveries, move pallets to the correct storage locations and supply the production lines with the materials they need. Thanks to your work, your colleagues can keep production running without unnecessary delays. 
You'll also be responsible for preparing finished products for shipment, checking outgoing orders and making sure everything is ready for transport ...
